title: GetAnimationVariableBool - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script

Gets the value of a variable on the reference's animation graph - Bool version.

Syntax:
bool Function GetAnimationVariableBool(string asVariableName) native

Parameters:
- asVariableName: The name of the variable to read from the graph

Return Value:
The value of the animation variable.

Examples:
Debug.Trace("Animation driven state: " + GetAnimationVariableBool("bAnimationDriven"))
